entity.name: Daniel Avila
entity.description: Creator and maintainer of Claude Code Templates (aitmpl.com), an open-source registry of components for AI coding agents. AI software engineer with 17+ years building developer tools, co-founder of CodeGPT (2.5M+ VS Code installs).

projects.name: Claude Code Templates
projects.description: Open-source registry and CLI for AI coding agent components: agents, commands, skills, hooks, MCP servers and settings. Developers browse aitmpl.com and install any component with one npx command. 1,900+ components, 33K+ GitHub stars, 3.8K+ forks, 130+ contributors and 215K+ npm downloads in the last 12 months. Every contributed component goes through automated security review (static analysis, NVIDIA SkillSpector and AI code review) before it reaches users, because installing third-party agent components is a software supply chain risk. The catalog is also published as a versioned public API that other tools build on. The registry is independent (not affiliated with Anthropic) and MIT licensed.
